title: A critical review of explainable deep learning in lung cancer diagnosis
core_idea: Critically examine emerging trends in explainable AI applied to lung cancer modeling, highlighting novel XAI implementations for tasks such as weakly supervised lesion localization, prognostic models, and survival analysis, while exploring clinician contributions, interobserver variability, evaluation and scoring of explanation maps, adaptation of XAI methods to medical imaging, and lung-specific attributes that influence XAI.
tldr: A focused review of explainable deep learning approaches for lung cancer imaging that surveys novel XAI implementations (localization, prognosis, survival), clinician involvement, evaluation of explanation maps, and adaptations needed for medical imaging and lung-specific factors.
